fusions.name: Overhead Drop
fusions.desc: Drops musk on an enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 11 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at maximum range, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wingbeat Waft
fusions.desc: A wingbeat drives 3 gusts of musk in a spread out to 6 tiles, each dealing 3 damage with a 25% chance to leave its target [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fanned Plume
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Owl-Wary
fusions.desc: Once every 8 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
